decision_target: Record the post-real-project Professional Code Authoring decision after B45-PCA-M28..M34.

owner_input.approval_scope: local docs/control-plane/spec/test edits and checks only

decision.reason: M27 already rejected CI/blocker promotion after the live behavior eval no-go, and M34 keeps real-project promotion blocked because runtime, test, TypeScript-advisory, reviewer-judgment and real AI-agent behavior-improvement evidence remain insufficient.
decision.current_recommendation: Keep the M25 advisory local, non-blocking and reversible; use M35 as a no-go promotion decision and only consider a source-only smaller treatment-v2 design or an approval-gated disposable runtime/browser pilot in later work.

evidence_used.summary: S6 decision kept the M25 advisory local/non-blocking and rejected stronger advisory, CI workflow creation and blocker enforcement after M26 live no-go behavior evidence.
Architecture v2 atlas defined the real-project scenario harness and promotion-governor boundaries without target execution.
Read-only inventory selected SOL and myPartners scenarios with approval boundaries and no source-body copy.
Fixture/source policy established allowed file classes, forbidden data, redaction, deletion and evidence-retention rules.
Two analysis-only sanitized fixture packs were created for SOL and myPartners while target workspaces remained read-only.
Baseline analysis was fixture-local/static with explicit SOL test/TypeScript gaps and myPartners syntax/advisory-only evidence.
Refactor comparison kept SOL as no-code churn prevention and compared myPartners checklist/advisory arms with no new dependencies and static/advisory proof only.
Scorecard ranked MP advisory-guided as best low-churn static arm, MP checklist-guided as blocked structure candidate and SOL no-code arms as churn prevention; critical gaps override averages.

keep_advisory_only.why: Supported by M27 no-go and M34 promotion-blocking scorecard.

design_smaller_treatment_v2.why: May be useful only if scoped to one narrow treatment question and kept out of target/runtime execution until approved.

run_more_fixture_pilots.why: More fixture pilots need a specific new scenario, treatment question and reviewer rubric.

request_disposable_runtime_browser_pilot.why: Runtime/browser proof is the main missing evidence, but no target, command, rollback or browser/provider boundary was approved in M35.

promote_ci_or_blocker.why: M27 rejected blocker/CI promotion and M34 does not reverse that evidence.

claim_real_ai_agent_behavior_improvement.why: M26 live eval was no-go and M34 was static fixture-local only.

accepted_gaps.not_accepted_for: promotion, target apply, product readiness or behavior improvement claims
accepted_gaps.residual_risk: The best static arm may not preserve target behavior.

accepted_gaps.accepted_for: blocking promotion and routing M35 to conservative no-go
accepted_gaps.not_accepted_for: final product acceptance of treatment v2 weights
accepted_gaps.residual_risk: Weights may need owner/reviewer calibration before any future treatment design.

current_no_go_conditions: Do not promote CI workflow creation or blocker enforcement.
Do not claim real AI-agent behavior improvement.
Do not apply MP checklist/advisory arms to target myPartners.
Do not implement SOL TypeScript treatment from the current fixture evidence.
future_go_conditions: Owner chooses a specific next route: treatment v2 design, more fixture pilots or disposable runtime/browser pilot.
Any treatment v2 starts as source-only design with explicit accepted gaps and no target apply.
Any runtime/browser pilot names the target, commands, rollback/delete path, data boundary, browser/provider boundary and evidence artifacts before execution.
Any stronger advisory, CI or blocker route reruns behavior eval and false-positive/flake/cost checks for the exact promoted surface.
A future promotion packet shows treatment evidence above baseline without critical regressions or unsupported runtime claims.
rollback_or_delete_path: To roll back M35 only: delete docs/superpowers/specs/batch45-real-project-decision-packet.json and remove B45-PCA-M35 rows from Track 11, PLAN, EVALS, RUNLOG, registry RU/EN and focused tests.
To retire S7 fixture evidence later: use the M30 source-policy deletion path and remove only the owned fixture/refactor/result directories after a separate cleanup decision.
Do not delete M28-M34 source artifacts as part of M35 rollback unless the owner explicitly requests S7 evidence retirement.
